subject: the committed shot uses the same aim yaw the targeting line is drawn from
method: lineYaw = published ShotInputState.AimYawRadians (the field ShotConeView draws from); ballYaw = bearing of the ball's own world motion over its first 25 m. Two independent ends of the system, never the same formula.
